Hamdan bin Mohammed welcomes participants to the UAE as the Annual Meeting of Global Future Leaders 2026 gets under way. Organised in partnership between the UAE Government, the World Economic Forum and Dubai Future Foundation, the meeting brings together more than 700 leaders and experts from 100 countries, including ministers and senior government officials, 300 Young Global Leaders and 150 UAE government leaders. The programme focuses on six strategic themes: Artificial Intelligence, Technology and Human Agency; Science, Discovery and Innovation; Economic Growth; Geopolitics, Security and Trade; Leadership and Human Flourishing; and Climate, Nature and Sustainability.
